---
name: new-adr
description: "Write an Architecture Decision Record for a significant design decision."
disable-model-invocation: true
argument-hint: "Decision title and the options considered"
---
Write an ADR with the [write-adr](../skills/write-adr/SKILL.md) skill for the decision described. Include at least
two real options, the consequences, and a **Verification** section naming the tests, eval gates or measurements
that prove the decision holds. Add it to the index in [docs/design/README.md](../../docs/design/README.md).
